title: Exploding Chickens
body:
Exploding Chickens

Chickens lay eggs… and explode! Handle with care.

Exploding Chickens adds a crazy twist to your feathered friends — every time a chicken lays an egg, it triggers an explosion causing chaos around you.

Features

🐔 Chickens explode immediately after laying an egg.

✅ Compatible with Minecraft 1.21.6

How to trigger the explosion

Simply wait for chickens to lay eggs — be ready to run

Installation

Place the .jar mod file in your .minecraft/mods/ folder.

Launch Minecraft with Forge 1.21.x.

Survive the explosive cluckers!
